name: com.liminallabs.atlas
description: The Liminal Labs Atlas core: one registry, one solve, and the vocabulary every view shares - markers, spaces, viewers, projections and presenter seams. Draws nothing itself; add Atlas Compass, Atlas On-Screen or Atlas Maps for that. Namespace LiminalLabs.Atlas.

samples.description: All three entry points tracked at once, with the raw solve printed on screen - no presenter, so it shows what the registry knows rather than how it looks. Import, then Window > Liminal Labs > Atlas > Build Core Sample Scene.
